output.headline: Aziz’s hat‑trick seals 3‑0 win
output.text: Southmere United opened the scoring with a 1.95‑xG finish from Tariq Aziz after a 19‑pass build‑up (e1013). A second goal followed at 58:49 when Aziz capitalised on a 0.16‑xG chance from Bruno Costa (e1286, e1287). The third came in the 86th minute, a 0.106‑xG finish aided by a 1‑pass assist from Joel Martin (e1850, e1851). Southmere’s 82 % passing accuracy, 50 % possession and 7.9 PPDA outmatched Harbour’s 85 % accuracy and 7.6 PPDA. The result hinged on Aziz’s clinical finishing and the team’s disciplined pressing (m099).
